turn.user_message: What happens after the two weeks?
turn.context: The ward-board loop: plan, try on one ward, measure, adjust, spread. A choice at the gate, not a mandate.

text: After two weeks we read the numbers and choose. If hours from ready to home fell, we spread it. If not, we adjust and try again.
Each new ward starts from the plan step. The software link comes in once two wards run well.
chat.pointer: Step round the loop. At Measure, answer the question and watch where it goes.
prompts: Where do the automations stand now?

moves.prompt: Where do the automations stand now?

blocks.title: Plan, try, measure, spread
blocks.deck: The same loop for every ward. Nothing spreads until the numbers say so.

steps.name: Plan
steps.what: Pick the ward. Name who records the times. Your Head of Operations says yes to the new order.

steps.name: Try on one ward
steps.what: Run the fourteen days. Three quiet days, then the changes in two steps.

steps.name: Measure
steps.what: Read the nine windows. Compare the trial days with days 1 to 3.

steps.name: Adjust
steps.what: Fix what did not work. Then run one more week on the same ward.

steps.name: Spread to more wards
steps.what: Add one or two wards at a time. Link the hospital software once two wards run well.

gate.question: Did hours from ready to home fall?
